dict.string: JARVIS records your voice while you hold the Option key, transcribes what you said, and sends it to your JARVIS conversation. The microphone is only live while you are holding the key or have locked recording on.
JARVIS uses the camera for hand-cursor tracking, letting you point and pinch to control the dashboard. The video never leaves your device.
JARVIS sends AppleScript commands to apps like Messages, Music, and Spotify to carry out your voice requests.
